field.zh: 生物信息学 · 抗菌材料与技术

intro.zh: 我的研究方向为生物信息学与抗菌材料，结合多组学数据分析与细胞、微生物和动物实验，开展发育生物学及抗菌材料相关研究。我于内蒙古大学获得动物学博士学位，并在化学化工学院完成博士后研究。
intro.en: My research focuses on bioinformatics and antimicrobial materials, combining multi-omics data analysis with cellular, microbiological and animal experiments. I received my Ph.D. in Zoology from Inner Mongolia University and completed postdoctoral research in its College of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering.

summary.zh: 已发表 SCI 论文 11 篇，其中第一作者 3 篇；主持科研项目 1 项，参与科研项目 2 项。
summary.en: I have published 11 SCI-indexed papers, including three as first author, and have led one research project and participated in two others.

text.zh: 围绕胚胎干细胞与发育生物学，开展 DNA 甲基化、ChIP-seq、ATAC-seq、RNA-seq 及单细胞转录组分析。
text.en: DNA methylation, ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, RNA-seq and single-cell transcriptomics in embryonic stem cells and developmental biology.

text.en: Antimicrobial polymer development, self-assembly and physicochemical characterization, with biological evaluation using cellular, microbiological and animal experiments.
